Version, the original project and licences
Lora, Inter Display and Poppins are bundled under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Fonts you add stay on your device under their own licences.
How long cards stay and when the island idles
How long things stay on the island. Applies instantly.
How long cards stay before returning to the idle cutout.
How long Low battery, Battery saver and Fully charged cards stay.
How long the small round cutout stays untouched before merging into the main one.
Removes a download or upload card not updated for this long. 0 keeps it until the app removes it.

Scales how long every pulse of the collapsed pill stays: notifications and events. 1x is as designed. A ringing call is not changed. Cards of quick events still leave on their own timer, so a longer pulse for them is cut at that point.
Hide the idle pill after a delay.
Speed of opening, closing and moving. Normal is the default.
How the small cutout joins the main one. Slide is the default; Bubble merges them into one liquid shape.
Distance of the circle and bar from the side edge in landscape. Raise it to move them inward.
White pill under an expanded card: pull down to open the app in a floating window. Off removes it and its swipe action.
Android\'s own freeform windows. Needs freeform support on your ROM (Developer options).
Uses the LMO Freeform app on LibreMobileOS ROMs and opens its main screen.
Short vibration when the island opens, closes or a swipe action runs. Holding the pill keeps its stronger pulse.
How easily swipes fire. High needs a shorter swipe; Low a longer, straighter one.
Show the island during Do Not Disturb
Keep showing cards while Do Not Disturb hides notifications. Sounds stay muted.
Tapping this app\'s card opens the big card.
Only loud (non-silent) notifications from this app auto-open its card.
Every new notification from this app auto-opens its card, silent ones too.
Silent needs Do Not Disturb access. Run Shizuku setup or allow it in system settings.
The second tab shows only once every cell of the first tab is filled.
Background apps stopped and cache cleared
Allow Smart Island to modify system settings to change brightness
Swipe up in quick-launch to reach it. Tap an empty cell to add a utility or widget; press and hold an item to move or swap it.
Selected. Tap an empty cell to move it there, or tap again to deselect.
Not chosen yet. You pick one the first time you tap it.
Turn on Floating window in the gesture settings to use this.
Live readouts on the collapsed cutout when nothing else is showing. Widgets take turns.
Time ticks over on the cutout every full hour (12 or 24 hour, like the system). No always-on clock.
Allow calendar access to show the next event. All-day, cancelled and declined events are skipped.
The date island shows your next event under the date (e.g. \"Standup · 10:30\"). Read on this phone only.
Off: battery also takes a turn when not charging. On: only while plugged in.
Hour on the left of the cutout, minute on the right. The island shows the time in large type over the full date.
Weekday and day of the month.
Temperature and conditions for your area. Refresh, place and display rules are in Settings > Idle widgets > Weather.
Battery level, green while charging and red when low.
When the next alarm rings. Skipped while no alarm is set.
Live download or upload speed of the whole device.
A glyph ticks in on the left at 6:00 (sunrise), 12:00 (afternoon), 17:30 (sunset) and 23:00 (midnight).
Unread messages and mail as a number. Tap for each app\'s count. Skipped when none.
Active mode (Do Not Disturb, Bedtime, Driving, …) as an icon; tap for its name. Telling modes apart needs Do Not Disturb access (Android 15+).
To show mode names like Bedtime or Driving (Android 15+), allow Smart Island under Do Not Disturb access. It only reads the mode.
Tap a widget to open it larger. It closes after this time untouched, or when you tap outside.
The battery island opens only while charging, showing percentage, time to full, temperature and this value.
Font of idle widget text on the collapsed pill. Glyphs are white.
Weather needs Network checks, which are off. Turn them on in Notifications and privacy.
Without location access, weather uses your internet connection\'s approximate place (wrong on a VPN).
Uses your approximate location (about 10 km). Only that rounded place goes to your weather provider (Open-Meteo by default).
Uses the city picked in Settings > Idle widgets > Weather. No location is read.
Uses only the last stored place. No new location or internet lookup.
In landscape the idle circle is small and shows only the value. Enlarge it in landscape position settings.
Switches per orientation, which widgets, tick timers
After closing the island with a tap on the cutout, no widget shows until you open it again.
Off after long press to hide
After hiding the pill with a long press, no idle widget shows until the pill returns.
These switches are for portrait. Landscape has its own on the Landscape tab.
These switches are for landscape. Portrait has its own on the Portrait tab.
Pick any of them. Several take turns in the order shown.
Drag a handle to reorder. The pinned widget always comes first.
Choose which widgets take turns during work hours, at night or while charging. Priority: charging, night, work hours.
Use its own list of widgets while the phone is charging.
Use its own list of widgets between these hours.
Use its own list of widgets between these hours.
Nothing is ticked, so no widget shows while this schedule is in force.
At least one widget stays selected. Turn all off with the main switch.
How often glyphs tick sideways, and a faster network speed ticks to its arrow.
How long a widget stays before its glyphs tick away in three steps and the next one enters.
Beat only when a value changes
Sideways beat plays only when something changes (e.g. new temperature or minute). Off: every beat.
Both timers are shared by portrait and landscape.
What the island needs to work: accessibility, notification access, Bluetooth and background permissions.
Necessary ones plus optional: Do Not Disturb, usage access and location (weather, Wi-Fi name).
Keep the collapsed cutout the same size when showing content. Off: it stretches to the size below, then shrinks back.
Keep the edge pill the same size when showing content. Off (default): it stretches to the size below, then shrinks back.
Choose which live cards stay on the island while their own app is open
Hide the island while a video or game has no status bar. Tap the camera cutout or wait for a new event to see it for a moment. Portrait, and landscape with the edge pill.
Hide the island completely while the notification shade or quick settings is open. It comes back when the shade closes.
Every utility cell is taken. Remove one first.
Hide the next alarm on the pill while it\'s more than 12 hours away.
Current wind speed and direction for your area. Uses the same lookup as Weather.
Where weather comes from and how often it updates. Applies to Weather and Wind widgets.
Uses your approximate location (about 10 km), or your internet connection\'s place without location access (wrong on a VPN).
Uses only the last stored place. Never reads your location, saving battery and data.
Allow approximate location once so there is a place to remember.
No place stored yet. Open this screen with location allowed, or switch to Auto once.
No city found. Check the spelling, or that Network checks is on.
No location permission needed. Search text goes to Open-Meteo; only the chosen city\'s rounded place is kept.
Longer interval saves battery and data. Nothing is fetched while Network checks or the screen are off.
Weather is fetched once, then only when you tap Refresh now.
Could not update. Check the place, the provider and your connection.
Free, no account or API key. Only the rounded place is sent.
Enter an https address, for example https://example.com/v1/forecast.
A service that answers like Open-Meteo\'s forecast API. It gets the rounded place and your key, which stays on this device and isn\'t backed up.
What the pill shows for weather. Feels like is drawn as ~19°.
Extra rows in the open weather island. Rows without a value are left out.
Air quality comes only from Open-Meteo, so it\'s hidden with a custom provider.
Pause while Battery Saver is on
Icons move (sun spin, rain fall). Off swaps them instantly. The system setting that removes animations keeps them still.
Shows only the busier direction: one arrow and one number, like ↓ 4.2M. Switches to ↑ when upload is higher.
Stays out of the rotation until the busier direction reaches this speed, and leaves once it falls clearly below.
Wi-Fi only: hidden on mobile data. Mobile only: hidden on Wi-Fi. The island shows today\'s total and a Data Saver line.
Off: always in the rotation, even when idle.
Judged on the latest reading. Severe alert = thunderstorm, heavy rain or snow, or freezing rain.
While a rule keeps weather off, the pill skips it but still fetches it. A selected severe alert also shows at night. Wind is unaffected.
Auto follows your region. Temperature applies to Weather and battery temperature; wind speed to Wind.
Off while a notification is stored
No idle widget shows while the island holds any notification; they return when none is left.
Glyphs change in short hops on an LED grid instead of one smooth slide.
Numbers 1 to 9, used in turn and repeated. 1, 2, 3 = one tick, then two, then three, then again.
Time between ticks. Lower is faster.
The value steps half a pace after the glyph. A new minute or temperature steps only the value; a new widget steps both.
Letters are drawn as dots. Any font, including added ones, becomes dots.
Applies to clock, date, weather, wind, battery, alarm and net speed. Notification count and mode glyphs keep the smooth tick.
Shizuku is not ready. Open Smart Island to set it up.
Notifications, sound and card behaviour for each app
No camera cutout detected. Pick where your camera is so the island lines up.
Nothing detected, so the island assumes a centre camera. Pick Center or Teardrop to adjust it.
No camera cutout was detected on this phone. Tell Smart Island where the camera is so the island lines up. You can change it later in Position, under Camera cutout.
